summary: Tested Gefaseerde Facturatie (Phased Invoicing) feature - all backend APIs and frontend UI working correctly. Manual invoice entries are correctly attributed to months based on invoice_date in the FinancesPage.

minor.issue: Returns 520 error (Billit integration issue) - does not affect manual invoice functionality

critical_code_review_comments: The Billit integration endpoint /api/projects/{project_id}/invoices returns 520 errors - this is a separate issue from the manual invoicing feature being tested
seed_data_creation: Used existing project 'Zinio & Amy' (PROJ-8DC83A0F) with existing manual invoice entry of €53,012.65 dated 2026-02-15
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gefaseerde Facturatie feature is fully functional. Project 'Zinio & Amy' (PROJ-8DC83A0F) has a manual invoice entry of €53,012.65 with invoice_date 2026-02-15. The FinancesPage correctly shows this amount under February 2026. All CRUD operations for manual invoices work correctly.

POST /api/projects/{project_id}/manual-i.details: Creates manual invoice entry with amount, description, invoice_date. Supports send_via_billit flag.

GET /api/projects/{project_id}/manual-in.details: Returns all manual invoice entries for a project sorted by invoice_date descending.

DELETE /api/projects/{project_id}/manual.details: Deletes manual invoice entry. Returns 404 for non-existent entries.

GET /api/all-manual-invoices.details: Returns all manual invoices across all projects for financial reporting.

ProjectCostsTab - Gefaseerde Facturatie.details: Form displays correctly with amount, date, description fields and Billit switch. Entries list shows all registered invoices with delete buttons. Total shows sum and percentage of sales price.

FinancesPage - Revenue from manual invoi.details: Monthly view correctly shows €53,012.65 under February 2026 based on invoice_date. Total revenue matches sum of all manual invoices.
